title: Trump at Malacañang as part of PH state visit
summary: US President Donald Trump arrived at Malacañang on Wednesday as part of his state visit to the Philippines.

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump arrived at Malacañang on Wednesday as part of his state visit to the Philippines.
President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. welcomed Trump at the Kalayaan Grounds within the Malacañang compound, followed by the playing of the national anthems of the two countries.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio accompanied Trump during his visit.

Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro, Finance Secretary Frederick Go, National Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro, Trade and Industry Secretary Cristina Roque, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez, presidential son Ilocos Norte Rep. Sandro Marcos, and US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton were also present to welcome Trump.
Marcos will hold a bilateral meeting with Trump. He will also host a state luncheon in honor of the US state leader.
Trump is in the Philippines from November 17-18.
He arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday late afternoon to attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits.
Marcos has expressed optimism about ASEAN’s "constructive engagement" with the US during the regional summit, saying their meeting is expected to produce outcome documents.

After Trump arrived in the Philippines, the Quad countries held a leaders' summit in Manila., where the US President announced that the bloc will conduct an exercise featuring maritime patrol aircraft. —AOL, GMA News
